project: Realm Forge - Autosave Indicator & Pin Display Fix
description: Move autosave indicator next to world title (Google Docs style) and fix autosave not triggering + pins not displaying

userStories.title: Move autosave indicator next to world title
userStories.description: Relocate the autosave status indicator from bottom overlay to next to the world title in the header, similar to Google Docs 'Saved' icon.
acceptanceCriteria: Move AutosaveIndicator from bottom of screen to WorldNavigation header
Show small icon next to world title (not full text)
Unsaved: Amber dot (like Google Docs)
Saving: Blue spinner
Saved: Green checkmark icon
Error: Red X icon
Icons only (no text) to save space
Add tooltip on hover to show full status text
Position: Immediately after world title, before navigation
Test: Add pin → Amber dot appears → Wait 3s → Green checkmark
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Better UX - status visible where user looks naturally (title area)

userStories.title: Fix autosave not triggering when adding pins
userStories.description: Critical bug: Autosave doesn't trigger when pins are added. The useAutosave hook needs to watch for pin changes in the world.
acceptanceCriteria: Investigate why autosave doesn't trigger on pin creation
Check if worldState object includes pins data
Update worldState to include pins array or pin count
Verify useAutosave hook detects pin changes
Test: Create pin → 'Unsaved' status appears after 3s → 'Saving' → 'Saved'
Test: Edit pin → Autosave triggers
Test: Delete pin → Autosave triggers
Verify database saves pin changes (check Prisma Studio)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: CRITICAL: Autosave only watches layers/grid/snap/scale, not pins
